name: Delaware
agency: Delaware DNREC, Division of Fish and Wildlife

rule.textEn: Anyone born on or after Jan. 1, 1978 must pass a boating safety course before running any motorized boat, PWC included.
rule.textEs: Quien nació el 1 de enero de 1978 o después debe aprobar un curso de seguridad náutica antes de manejar cualquier embarcación con motor, incluidas las motos acuáticas.

minAge.note: PWC from 14 with the course and an adult on board at 14-15; alone from 16 with the certificate.

sources.quote: Persons born on or after January 1, 1978 must successfully complete a boating safety course before operating a motorized boat, including personal watercraft, on Delaware waters.

Personal watercraft operators who are 14 and 15 years old are required to have an adult on board. Those who are 16 years of age, who hold a boating safety education certificate, can operate without adult supervision.
Several online courses also meet the requirement.
